description: This file defines the abstract base class PdfAcroField for PDF interactive form fields within the PdfSharp library. It includes properties and methods for managing field attributes such as name, flags, values, hierarchical relationships (children/parents), descendant fields, appearance names, and type-specific creation logic. The class also contains inner classes for field collection management and dictionary keys relevant to PDF form fields.

classes.name: PdfAcroField
classes.description: Abstract base class representing all interactive PDF form fields, managing properties such as name, flags, value, hierarchy, and appearance; also provides internal mechanisms for descendant management and dynamic field creation based on PDF dictionary attributes.

classes.name: PdfAcroField.PdfAcroFieldCollection
classes.description: Collection class managing multiple child fields within a parent field, offering access by index or name, with methods to retrieve descendant names and create specific field instances based on PDF dictionaries.

classes.name: PdfAcroField.Keys
classes.description: Static class defining PDF dictionary keys relevant to form fields, including type, parent, children, name, flags, value, default value, appearance, and other attribute keys.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieve a child field by name, considering hierarchical structure with dot notation for nested fields.

methods.name: CreateAcroField
methods.description: Factory method that returns a specific derived field type instance based on the PDF dictionary's field type and flags.
